load_wav_to_torch: load a WAV audio file from disk into a PyTorch FloatTensor with optional sample rate resampling
read_binary_audio: read binary audio bytes into a PyTorch FloatTensor with optional resampling to a target sample rate
load_code_dict: load a unit code dictionary from a text file with optional SOS and EOS token support
get_mask_from_lengths: create a boolean padding mask tensor from a sequence of variable sequence lengths
CudaTimer: measure and track GPU operation timing across multiple named keys using CUDA events
